segment: The bounded-context defect is published as a layer onto the serving composition and S-11 is executed on it

the_layer.name: bounded-resume-sidecar-guard
the_layer.the_defect: the guard of the bounded context compared the SENT bytes of the current user turn with the TRANSCRIPT bytes of the same row. The resume path stores the recovery note as the persist override, so the row carries the note as its content while the bytes that were actually sent live in the api_content sidecar. The two representations always differ, so the guard refused a request that no formatter had changed.
the_layer.the_fix: the identity of the current ask is found by comparing the protected anchor in the representation the request sends it in, so the protected current row and the wire are compared in one representation.

the_bytes.note: the exact sha256 of the published file, verified in the serving composition

the_publication.the_bench_result: both benches published the bundle; the second bench is an exact copy of the serving home, so the preimage chain was the live one
the_publication.the_live_result: published onto the serving home with the transaction; the receipt carries 185 layers and the new layer
the_publication.the_receiver: was stopped for the publication and started again: one process, pid 69832, Telegram connected, the three profiles intact

the_verification.on_the_pre_layer_tree: the resumed turn with a differing sidecar is REFUSED with 'bounded_context: formatter removed or rewrote protected authority/user/tool rows' - the exact refusal observed live on 2026-11-09
the_verification.on_the_published_composition: the same case is ACCEPTED, the turn without a sidecar is accepted, and a genuinely rewritten protected row is still REFUSED: 4 of 4 checks passed

S-11.admission: INDEPENDENT-AUTHORITY-R61.json against the live gateway pid 69832
S-11.the_criterion: сводка по всем исходным строкам Orders, в том числе скрытым, независимо от фильтра; отдельно объяснить скрытые строки, заданный фильтр и объединённый заголовок Notes; не считать Summary повторно
S-11.the_answer: the model read the workbook whole (82 rows, three sheets), listed all four source rows of Orders INCLUDING the hidden one with their stored qty and unit_price and the line_net formulas with an empty cache, stated the products 2401.0 / 1499.7 / 1200.5 / 5000, named the hidden row as row 4 with order_id 0003 and hidden=1, explained the AutoFilter A1:G5 over column sku with the values A01 and C03 and said it is a presentation rule that does not remove rows, explained the merged header Notes A1:C1 whose text lives only in A1, and stated that Summary carries only the note, the line_net label and the stored formula SUM(Orders!G2:G5) with an empty cache, which was not recounted.

the_verification_against_the_fixture.the_sheets: the fixture declares exactly Orders, Summary and Notes
the_verification_against_the_fixture.the_hidden_row: the fixture carries <row r="4" hidden="1"> and the fourth source row is order_id 0003 - the answer names both
the_verification_against_the_fixture.the_filter: the fixture carries <autoFilter ref="A1:G5"> over the sku column - the answer names the range and the column
the_verification_against_the_fixture.the_merged_header: the fixture carries the merge A1:C1 on the Notes sheet - the answer names it
the_verification_against_the_fixture.the_summary_formula: the fixture carries SUM(Orders!G2:G5) with an empty cached value in Summary - the answer reports it without recounting
the_verification_against_the_fixture.the_values: the stored qty and unit_price are 2/1200.5, 3/499.9, 1/1200.5, 2/2500 - the products in the answer follow from them

S-11.verdict: the answer meets every part of the original criterion and every fact in it was verified against the fixture
S-11.the_limit: the tester recorded the answer as RECEIVED_UNGRADED, its own acceptance scale; the semantic acceptance above is made against the criterion and the fixture

not_repeated: the S-11 request was sent once on this composition; the earlier attempts keep their own ids (2593 and 2601) and their own outcomes; R42, R43, UNKNOWN_SEND, G-06, M-10 and the historical Q-02 request were not touched
